author: Contributor 78
about: Ada publishes explicitly synthetic transport bytes in a public model-type repository to reproduce localrouter’s pinned downloads. Bob reads them anonymously; no inference is claimed.

steps.name: Ada creates her Hub account and a write token for publishing a public transfer fixture
Bob creates a separate account; he has no grant to Ada’s repository
Ada creates ada/tiny-embed to reproduce a localrouter cache transfer problem
Ada’s setup job was interrupted after creation; she resumes it on the next day
The resumed setup retries creation and learns that Ada’s repository already exists

expect.equals: You already created this model repo

steps.name: Ada asks Git LFS where to upload the binary transfer fixture
The uploader sends a truncated payload after reading the wrong local file; it is rejected
Ada selects the complete 4096-byte fixture and uploads it to the returned URL
The restarted LFS uploader checks its batch; the completed object needs no second transfer
Ada publishes the transfer manifest and LFS pointer on main

files.README.md:
# Transfer fixture
Synthetic bytes for a localrouter download diagnostic. This repository does not contain an inference model.

steps.author: Ada <ada@volter.ai>

steps.name: Bob clones the public fixture so he can reproduce the transfer problem without Ada’s credentials
The diagnostic cache pins the published commit and resolves its transfer manifest
The cache follows the returned resolve-cache URL and reads the manifest
After a connection interruption at byte 10, the cache resumes the manifest with its saved ETag
The cache resolves the pinned binary fixture and saves the returned CDN URL
The cache downloads the binary fixture; its bytes are exactly what Ada uploaded

steps.name: A restart finds the entire fixture in its partial file and asks at offset 4096; the cache can verify and adopt it
The fixture remains published; Bob returns with the cache’s next-day diagnostic
With the repository name corrected, the cache resolves the current manifest from main
The cache follows the corrected manifest’s returned URL
Bob checks the model repository information behind the corrected download name
The same repository-information check refuses the copied typo
